claims.value: A native omnimodal model with strong agentic capabilities, supporting text, image, video, and audio understanding within a unified architecture.
claims.evidence: MiMo-V2.5 is a native omnimodal model with strong agentic capabilities
Built upon the MiMo-V2-Flash backbone and extended with dedicated vision and audio encoders
The context window supports up to 1M tokens
MiMo-V2.5's core language backbone inherits from the MiMo-V2-Flash architecture, a sparse MoE model
Post-training incorporates SFT, large-scale agentic RL, and Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation (MOPD)

claims.value: Native omnimodal model trained on ~48T tokens, using sparse MoE architecture (310B total, 15B activated parameters) with hybrid sliding window attention. Supports text, image, video, and audio inputs within a 1M token context window.
claims.evidence: MiMo-V2.5 is trained on a total of ~48T tokens. Text Pre-training
